business_summary: Capstone Copper Corp., a copper mining company, mines, explores for, and develops mineral properties in the United States, Chile, and Mexico. The company primarily explores copper, silver, gold, molybdenum, zinc, iron, cobalt, and other base metals. Capstone Copper Corp. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
